timingRepresentation.reason: Use exact integer arithmetic for ordinary binary values and simple triplets; do not use floating-point timing.

sourceEvidence.rule: Keep original MIDI ticks and all source meta events separate from derived notation.

eventModel.noteOrChord: Notes in the same source part with the same quantized onset form one simultaneous group.
eventModel.rest: Rests are derived from quantized gaps and decomposed deterministically into supported duration values.
eventModel.measure: Measures are constructed from the active time signature. If no time signature is present, 4/4 is an internal fallback with a diagnostic and is not claimed as source metadata.
eventModel.parts: Preserve parser sourcePart=(trackIndex,channel); do not infer engraved voices or hand assignment.

onsetGrid.conversion: nearest integer notation unit to tick*48/PPQN, using integer arithmetic and deterministic half-up tie handling

duration.selection: Choose the nearest explicitly supported duration candidate; equal-distance ties choose the longer value.

restDecomposition.algorithm: Greedy longest-value decomposition constrained by measure boundaries, with deterministic fallback; if exact decomposition is impossible, fail rather than invent duration.

recommendedFreeze.reason: 96 is the least simple binary-multiple grid that exactly represents the frozen base values, dotted 64th (9 units), and simple triplets through 32nd (4 units) without floating-point timing.
recommendedFreeze.onsetRounding: nearest; exact half ties round forward

openDecisions.question: The frozen Phase 14.2b contract says single-dotted forms through 64th are supported, but a dotted 64th equals 3/32 quarter and cannot be represented on the otherwise natural 48-units-per-quarter integer grid.
safeChoices: Narrow initial dotted support to dotted 32nd and longer.
openDecisions.recommendation: Use 96 units per quarter. It exactly represents dotted 64ths and all currently frozen simple triplet values while retaining integer arithmetic.

openDecisions.question: Freeze the smallest triplet value supported initially. The Phase 14.2b wording says simple triplet subdivision when representable but does not define a floor.
openDecisions.recommendation: Support triplet half/quarter/eighth/sixteenth/thirty-second values initially; defer 64th-note triplets.

openDecisions.question: Freeze handling of a note that crosses a derived measure boundary before Music Braille tie encoding exists.
openDecisions.recommendation: Split it into measure-bounded notation segments carrying a derived tie flag; actual Braille tie rendering remains deferred.

openDecisions.question: Freeze time-signature changes occurring away from an already derived measure boundary.
openDecisions.recommendation: Require changes at a quantized measure boundary initially; otherwise return UNSUPPORTED_MUSIC_BRAILLE_CONSTRUCT.

next: Phase 14.4b should freeze 96 units/quarter, exact integer quantization, notation score/part/measure/event types, rest decomposition, chord grouping, overlap rejection, measure crossing split/tie metadata, and time-signature-change policy. Do not implement Music Braille cell rules or Word UI yet.
